fact_text: Contributions to a Pakistani voluntary pension scheme can be claimed as a tax rebate equal to 20% of taxable income, as the interviewee explained it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: At retirement, 50% of a voluntary pension fund withdrawal is tax free and the remaining 50% is taxed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: Withdrawing from a voluntary pension scheme before retirement is taxed at the average effective tax rate of the previous three years, applied to the full withdrawal including profit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: Gains inside a voluntary pension fund are not taxed while the investor stays invested, because the fund pays no dividend and no capital gains tax arises without a sale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: Almeezan's pension range covers equity, money market and income funds, plus a gold fund that the interviewee called unique, with four sub-funds for private-sector members.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: Almeezan's CEO said it has a voluntary pension arrangement with the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government and is rolling out similar schemes with the Punjab and Balochistan governments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: Under the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa scheme, new hires after a set date move from a defined benefit pension to defined contribution: salary deduction plus an equal government contribution, managed by an AMC the employee chooses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: Almeezan's voluntary pension scheme can be opened online through the government portal with a minimum investment of PKR 1,000, according to its CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: The interviewee put Pakistan's pension fund market at about PKR 120 billion, up from about PKR 15 billion, and still small relative to the size of the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: Almeezan's pension scheme includes takaful cover that pays up to a PKR 5 million sum insured on natural death, double that on accidental death, and waives the early-withdrawal tax penalty for disability or death.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: In its pension scheme the investor can shift allocation between fund types at any time and track the position in real time, while a provident fund shows performance once a year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: The CEO argued a provident fund applies one strategy to every member, while a pension scheme lets each investor's allocation suit their age and risk profile.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: The interviewee argued a voluntary pension fund stays intact when a worker changes employer, while a provident fund's accumulated balance is terminated on a job change.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: The CEO expects uptake of voluntary pension schemes in Pakistan to grow strongly over the next five to ten years as retirement is increasingly self-funded.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: The CEO said companies are adopting voluntary pension schemes for staff because it outsources retirement-fund accounting and administration away from the employer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: The interviewee argued pension savings and equities can beat inflation over the long run, provided the government keeps real interest rates positive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)

fact_text: The CEO said the main risk of a 100% equity pension allocation is market volatility on the day of redemption, which a long holding period usually allows the investor to ride out.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why You Need to Start Saving for Retirement Immediately (With Number Examples) | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-05)
